The Patch! standard

Built to your spec. Built properly. Yours to run.

By stating your spec, you set the boundaries of your build. We make sure what's inside them is built right — and we hold the door when you're ready to cross them.

01 Built to your verified spec

You describe what you're trying to accomplish. We read it, understand it, and if we see a better way, we lay out the reasoning in writing — you rule. The build follows the spec you approved, never just your first words.

02 Built properly

Our build quality doesn't bend to a sloppy spec. If something in the plan would break later, we say so before we build it — build quality is the builder's standard, and it doesn't move.

03 You can run it

Every fix ships with clear instruction for your team. We show you the leap is safe — the landing is engineered — so the fix keeps working after we hand it back.

04 The edge is the edge

Your build covers exactly what the stamped scope says. When you outgrow it — and growing businesses do — that's the next conversation, and we'll be ready.

Questions

Before you ask

Why flat price instead of hourly?

Because you should know the number before the work starts, not after. The diagnostic produces a stamped plan with a flat price and a pass/fail acceptance test. No hourly billing, no surprise invoices — the price agreed in writing is the price.

What do I actually get for the $250 diagnostic?

A written findings report: what's actually wrong, what a fix requires, and a stamped plan with a flat price and an acceptance test. If you sign for the fix within 30 days, the full $250 is credited toward it.

When is the balance for a fix due?

A Fix Sprint starts with a 50% deposit. The balance is due only when the fix passes the acceptance test agreed in writing before work began — you verify it works the way we said it would, then you pay the rest.

What if you recommend a different approach than I described?

We lay out the reasoning in writing, in full, and you rule on each recommendation — accepted or declined. Declined stays declined. The build follows the verified spec you approved, and our quality standard applies either way: if part of a plan would break later, we tell you before we build it.

What happens when I outgrow my build?

Your build covers exactly what the stamped scope says — that edge is deliberate, so the price and the promise stay exact. Outgrowing it is the next conversation: a new diagnostic or an ongoing-care retainer ($300–$750/month) picks up from solid ground instead of a workaround pile.
